chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Nu'aym ibn Ibrahim al-Azdi, from Misma', from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام:

Concerning a man who killed the fetus of a slave-woman belonging to a people while it was in her womb, he said: So he said, “If it died in her womb after he struck her, then half of one-tenth of the value of its mother is upon him. And if he struck her and she delivered it alive, then it died afterward, then one-tenth of the value of its mother is upon him.”

key_terms.أَمَةٍ: slave-woman; the mother whose market value determines the compensation
key_terms.بَطْنِهَا: her womb; indicating the fetus died before birth
key_terms.جَنِينِ: fetus; the unborn child in the womb
key_terms.عُشْرَ قِيمَةِ أُمِّهِ: one-tenth of its mother’s value; the compensation when it is born alive and then dies
key_terms.نِصْفُ عُشْرِ قِيمَةِ أُمِّهِ: half of one-tenth of its mother’s value; the compensation when the fetus dies in the womb

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due if someone causes the death of the fetus of a slave-woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on compensation for causing the death of the fetus of a slave-woman. It distinguishes between the fetus dying in the womb after the ضرب and being born alive and then dying later, assigning a different financial liability in each case.
